description: A studio film, at its own higher price: for when the owner wants a scripted film with voices, characters or generated footage (moving clips), not a short for a feed, which code_film makes for less. When it helps the owner choose, quote both. The writers' room writes its script, the director plans and makes it, and it opens on its own board where the owner reads the script, picks the voices and sees the plan before anything costly is made (Step through). With run false nothing is laid out or spent and the answer is the video's cost table: each part, the price at each quality and of each kind, and the script that comes first; say the total and the first step. With run true it is laid out on the canvas, commissioned, and the owner lands on its board; its script (the first step, a few thousand tokens) is written at once. run true only when the owner clearly asked to make it now. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

aspect.description: the film's shape; 9:16 unless the owner says otherwise

channel.description: where the finished film is meant to go, set as its post's place on the board; nothing is posted without the owner

context.description: who it is for and what they know: a client's brief, a meme's context, anything the writer should read

direction.description: any key and value an art director would write (lighting, camera, emotions, vibe, in the style of, anything), one pair each; used beside the brand's defaults

energy.description: how wild the film may be; auto lets the brief decide

goal.description: what the film is for, in one line

kind.description: the kind of video: moving (generated clips from first frames, talking shots with their voice), images (still pictures edited together, no generated video: less than half the price of moving) or drawn (drawn in code); moving unless the owner says

length.description: the film's length in seconds; omit and Marsell decides

music.description: a music bed under it: always, none, or auto for Marsell to decide

pictureIds.description: the business's own pictures the film uses, by their file ids

productIds.description: products from the business's catalogue the film shows, by their ids

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

quality.description: hd (1080p, Full HD), standard (768p, only for a quick test the owner asks for; finish it in HD later keeping its takes) or 2k; hd unless the owner says

run.description: true makes it now: laid out on the canvas and made as a video on its own board (the script first, nothing costly before the owner's yes); false only prices it

sound.description: who is heard: speech (the people on screen speak their lines), narration (a narrator over the picture), design (no voice; sound, music and words on screen); auto: a narrator and anyone the script gives a line

story.description: the story or context in the owner's words: what happens, where, the feeling; the writer reads it with the goal

name: canvas_film
title: Canvas film
